468:t_036:7.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Yes...! That will be the beginning of the true battle!」

468:t_036:9.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Do not get above yourself, human! Even if you master the power of light, you are ultimately worthless before the battles of the gods!」

468:t_036:10.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「You will learn that soon enough! And that time is almost upon you!」

468:t_037:0.en:
$n
「That $$ハーデス$$ is going to return...」

468:t_037:1.en:
$$渓$$
「There's no need to be scared. No matter how much he bluffs, if he comes back, we'll beat him again.」

468:t_037:2.en:
$$凱$$
「That's right. We've got the Demon God of Light on our side too.」

468:t_037:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「Big talk, $$凱$$! You were pretty damn worried when $$ガラダブラ$$ showed up!」

468:t_037:4.en:
$$凱$$
「I don't wanna hear that from a guy who only fights when the $$くろがね五人衆$$ kick his ass into gear.」

468:t_037:6.en:
$$つばさ$$
「More or less. I put you through a lot of worry and trouble too.」

468:t_037:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's skip that stuff between mother and son.」

468:t_037:11.en:
$$つばさ$$
「He even left his nutrient solution to try to bring you Photon Power. He knew what he was risking.」

468:t_037:14.en:
$$つばさ$$
「I took his life once... So this time, I'll do everything I can to keep him alive.」

468:t_037:15.en:
$$甲児$$
「I understand. I'll leave Dad to you, Mom.」

468:t_037:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's a matter between husband and wife, after all.」

468:t_037:17.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...You sure talk like a grown man now...」

468:t_037:21.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... Getting worn out by that little... I must be losing my edge...」

468:t_037:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...Sorry... Just let me... sleep... a lit...」

468:t_038:1.en:
$$安$$
「Damn right! We ain't the $$くろがね五人衆$$ for nothing!」

468:t_038:2.en:
$n
「You might even be stronger than $$ボロット$$ itself.」

468:t_038:3.en:
$$ボス$$
「H-Hey! Their strength is part of $$ボロット$$ too!」

468:t_038:4.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「Even if you're jealous, we ain't sharing!」

468:t_038:6.en:
$$お菊$$
「Now, now, boys... Don't be so mean.」

468:t_038:7.en:
$$お菊$$
「$n, dear... I hear your copilot's seat is empty. Would you like me to come fill in?」

468:t_100:0.en:
$$甲児$$
(I have to go after $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I don't have time to deal with this guy!)

468:t_100:1.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Your mind is elsewhere! Do not think you can defeat me in that state!」

468:t_100:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Damn it! I really can't go any farther without beating him!」

468:t_100:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then I'll just have to do it! Get ready, $$ガラダブラ$$!」

468:t_101:0.en:
$$ガラダブラ$$
「Humans! Do not think that is the full extent of Lord $$ハーデス$$' power!」

468:t_101:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are you all right, $$竜馬$$?! Are your wounds from protecting me hurting?!」

468:t_101:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Quit worrying about nothing! I taught you more than enough times what happens when you lose focus in a fight!」

468:t_101:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yes, sir! Of course I haven't forgotten!」

468:t_101:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Then quit thinking about stupid crap! Let's hurry up and finish these dead bastards from hell!」

468:t_102:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
(Hang on, $$甲児$$...! I'll be there soon!)

468:t_102:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
(I won't let you die! I'll save you, even if it costs me my life!)

468:t_103:1.en:
$n
(Damn it...! I can't think about anything else right now! I have to focus on beating the enemy!)
